description: This Java class defines a web filter 'RateLimitProcessingFilter' that enforces rate limiting on API requests based on user roles and tenant information within the Thingsboard platform. It intercepts HTTP requests, checks rate limits via 'RateLimitService', and handles rate limit exceptions or errors accordingly.

classes.name: RateLimitProcessingFilter
classes.description: A web filter that enforces rate limiting on API requests based on user and tenant information.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Intercepts HTTP requests to check and enforce rate limits based on user roles and tenant info.

methods.name: shouldNotFilterAsyncDispatch
methods.description: Indicates whether to skip filtering for async dispatches; returns false.

methods.name: shouldNotFilterErrorDispatch
methods.description: Indicates whether to skip filtering for error dispatches; returns false.

methods.name: rateLimitExceeded
methods.description: Handles the scenario when rate limit is exceeded by sending an error response.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user from security context.
